scope: Repository-known external services and deployment-dependent processors

entries.activation_condition: SUPPORT_PROVIDER=zoho_desk and direct support submission is enabled/configured
entries.operator_action_before_activation: Verify account/data-center, provider retention/deletion controls, access roles, and contract/DPA position; never attach credentials or raw financial records automatically.

entries.purpose: Checkout, recurring billing and payment lifecycle
entries.activation_condition: BILLING_CHECKOUT_ENABLED=true with live Razorpay credentials/provider objects
entries.operator_action_before_activation: Complete roadmap payment acceptance, verify exact checkout/webhook data flow, provider retention/refund records and legal/tax obligations.

entries.activation_condition: Pluggy client credentials are configured and users connect accounts
entries.operator_action_before_activation: Verify production account, consent/reconnect/revocation behavior, retention/deletion/export controls and supported geography.

entries.activation_condition: Enable Banking application/key material is configured and users connect accounts
entries.operator_action_before_activation: Verify production application, consent expiry/revocation, liability classification, retention/deletion and supported institutions.

entries.activation_condition: SIMPLEFIN_ENABLED=true and a user supplies a supported SimpleFIN setup token/connection
entries.operator_action_before_activation: Verify production bridge/provider, retention/deletion, disconnect behavior and account/liability classification.

entries.purpose: Transactional verification, password recovery and account email
entries.activation_condition: SMTP_HOST and SMTP_FROM_EMAIL are configured; production local auth may require delivery
entries.operator_action_before_activation: Record the actual provider legal/service name, region, retention/log policy, deletion controls and contract/DPA position before production.
Record the actual provider/bucket region, encryption/access controls, lifecycle/deletion behavior and backup replication.

entries.activation_condition: OIDC is enabled with client/discovery configuration
entries.operator_action_before_activation: Record the actual IdP, claim set, account-linking mode, region, retention/deletion and contract position.
Verify current terms/limits and avoid sending user identity or transaction records.

entries.purpose: Market symbol search and price lookup
entries.operator_action_before_activation: Treat portfolio-symbol queries as potentially revealing and verify provider usage/terms before public production.
Keep requests limited to public reference data; do not send user identity or portfolio records.

entries.service: Approved external LLM/provider route through FinCopilot/OmniRoute or configured agent connection
entries.purpose: AI assistance, retrieval and tool-mediated explanations
entries.activation_condition: AGENTS/AI is enabled with a non-local external model/provider route
data_categories: tool outputs approved for the model request
entries.operator_action_before_activation: Roadmap #6/#49/#50 must pin the exact production provider/model(s), verify prompt training/retention/privacy terms, geography, deletion and tool/data minimisation. No broad provider pool may be treated as approved by this inventory.

entries.purpose: Run and expose FinCopilot production infrastructure
data_categories: encrypted and/or hosted application data depending on architecture
entries.operator_action_before_activation: Roadmap #1/#2 must record the actual provider, region, logs/backups, access controls, deletion/export and contract/DPA position.

entries.purpose: Receive security vulnerability reports separately from customer support
entries.activation_condition: A reporter uses the configured private security-reporting route
entries.operator_action_before_activation: Keep security reports separate from customer support and avoid asking reporters for unnecessary user financial data.
